meta.title: Local Video Screening
meta.description: Turns a long video into timecoded subtitles, a timeline, an outline and candidate key frames using deterministic media signals, local Qwen3-ASR and local vision/text models. Models are reported and confirmed before any heavy work.

tools.plan: Probe the environment and models, report what this run will use and how long it should take
tools.scan: Extract audio, run local ASR, detect scene cuts and sample coarse frames
tools.caption: Caption the coarse frames with the local vision model and score their importance
tools.timeline: Fold the transcript into a timeline, chapters and an outline, then pick key frames
tools.export: Write the SRT, the timeline Markdown and native-resolution key frames
tools.frames: Return original frames for one time range so the main model can look at them directly
